summary: CI owns the version in all six (https://sharness.ai/articles/ci-owns-the-version.html): after the gate, CI writes VERSION in a GitHub Actions commit, tags it and deploys it; release.sh never touches VERSION, and a pushed change to it fails the guard. First CI versions: press v1.0.58, data v0.1.52, team, site, refs, updates v0.22.39. Data and press are served from their history (every published version byte for byte; each file once by hash; data 203 MB instead of 763, press 92 MB instead of 507, under Pages' 1 GB cap). Every page reads the press and data from /latest/ (the editor's decision). The brief on the six centers of gravity published with five diagrams. Board dev-0003 asks the editor for the tag ruleset.
